description: Fetch analytics for one participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email. The base response includes all-time engagement, rank, share, and applicable affiliate revenue, commission, and payout metrics. Add `activation` to `include` for the program-specific eligibility anchor and covered first milestones, including `firstPortalViewedAt` and `firstShareChannel`. A null milestone with a partial or unavailable `state` is unknown, not proof that the action never happened. Request both `activation` and `series` for covered `portalViews` and `shareActions` buckets. Date-window parameters filter optional series and email data, not the base response or activation milestones. Targets `campaignId` if passed, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

days.description: Number of days for optional `series` and `email` analytics. Does not filter the all-time base response.

endDate.description: End of the optional-data timeframe, Unix timestamp in ms. Use with `startDate`.

include.description: Comma-separated optional data. Current values are `series`, `email`, and `activation`; the API returns `400` for unknown values.

interval.description: Bucket size for `series` and email series. Defaults to `day`.

startDate.description: Start of the optional-data timeframe, Unix timestamp in ms. Use with `endDate` instead of `days`.

name: growsurf_get_participant_analytics

activation.description: Opt-in covered eligibility and first-milestone analytics for one participant.

cohort.description: Program-specific eligibility anchor and covered value.

anchorAt.description: Covered anchor time (Unix ms). `null` is unknown and does not mean enrollment never occurred.

coverageStartAt.description: Earliest expected complete participant activation capture time (Unix ms).

enrolledAsAdvocateAt.description: Referral only. Covered advocate enrollment (Unix ms); `null` does not mean enrollment never occurred.

metricContractVersion.description: Shared activation and engagement metric version.

milestones.description: Covered first milestones. A `null` value is unknown and does not mean the action never happened.

firstCommissionAt.description: Affiliate only. First covered commission (Unix ms).

firstPortalViewedAt.description: First covered signed-in portal view (Unix ms).

firstRewardAt.description: Referral only. First covered participant reward (Unix ms).

firstShareAt.description: First covered accepted share action (Unix ms).

firstShareChannel.description: Channel for `firstShareAt`, or `null` when the first covered share is unavailable.

firstUniqueClickAt.description: First covered unique referral visit (Unix ms).

reason.description: Why a value is partial or unavailable, or `null` when it is available.

state.description: Whether the value is complete, partial, or unavailable for the requested bounds.

analytics.description: All-time participant analytics totals. Date-window parameters do not filter these fields.

currencyISO.description: Program currency for the money metrics.

monthlyReferrals.description: Referrals credited in the current month.

referralRevenue.description: Affiliate only. Revenue attributed to this participant's referrals, in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

referrals.description: All-time referrals credited to this participant.

rewardStatus.description: This participant's reward counts, separate from referral-credit status.

unfulfilled.description: Customer-approved rewards that have not been fulfilled.

totalCommissions.description: Affiliate only. Total commissions earned, in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

totalPaidOut.description: Affiliate only. Total paid out, in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

upcomingPayout.description: Affiliate only. Approved commissions ready to pay, in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

email.description: Sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, and spam complaint metrics for program emails in the requested window.

bounceRate.description: Bounced divided by sent, from 0 to 1.

byType.description: Metrics grouped by configured email type, ordered by `emailType`.

bounceRate.description: Bounced divided by sent, from 0 to 1.

clickRate.description: Clicked divided by delivered, from 0 to 1.

clicked.description: Emails with at least one tracked link click.

delivered.description: Emails delivered or subsequently opened or clicked.

deliveryRate.description: Delivered divided by sent, from 0 to 1.

emailType.description: Configured program email type or step.

openRate.description: Opened divided by delivered, from 0 to 1.

clickRate.description: Clicked divided by delivered, from 0 to 1.

clicked.description: Emails with at least one tracked link click.

coverageStartDate.description: Earliest expected complete coverage date (Unix ms), or `null` when unavailable.

delivered.description: Emails delivered or subsequently opened or clicked.

deliveryRate.description: Delivered divided by sent, from 0 to 1.

isPartial.description: Whether the requested window starts before `coverageStartDate`.

openRate.description: Opened divided by delivered, from 0 to 1.

endDate.description: Window end (Unix ms). Present with `series` or `email`.

series.description: This participant's per-period activity. Present when `include` contains `series`.

items.description: Per-period activity totals plus `periodStart` (Unix ms, UTC).

copyRefLinkShares.description: Times participants copied their referral link.

email.description: Per-period email counts when both optional values are requested.

clicked.description: Emails with at least one tracked link click.

delivered.description: Emails delivered or subsequently opened or clicked.

periodStart.description: Start of the period (Unix ms, UTC).

portalViews.description: Covered signed-in portal views, or `null` outside known coverage.

referralCreditExpireds.description: Referred friends whose referral-credit window expired before credit was awarded.

referralCreditPendings.description: Referred friends whose referral credit has not yet been awarded.

referrals.description: Referrals whose credit has been awarded.

shareActions.description: Covered accepted share actions, or `null` outside known coverage.

totalCommissionCount.description: Affiliate programs only. Number of commission records.

totalCommissions.description: Affiliate programs only. Commissions in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

totalRevenue.description: Affiliate programs only. Revenue in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

uniqueCommissionReferrals.description: Affiliate programs only. Number of unique referred participants represented by commissions in the requested timeframe.

startDate.description: Window start (Unix ms). Present with `series` or `email`.
